messages:
mira: Heads up: dashboard p99 for /generate dropped below p95 for last 12h. Anyone else seeing this?
ed: yikes. can you paste the query and route filters?
mira: query: filter route = '/generate' group by endpoint, percentile 95/99. screenshot shows p95=320ms p99=280ms. 🤔
sasha: this usually means we're merging quantiles incorrectly during rollup. are we using per-shard tdigests or sketch summaries?
jamal: we store per-host tdigest and roll up by merging them. merging can yield non-monotonic percentiles if summaries are compressed badly.
ed: right — tdigest with aggressive compression + small sample counts can flip ordering.
zara: would grouping by raw samples (when available) fix? Can console do raw-merge for small time ranges?
mira: console query used the 'rollup' path with 1m window. small routes sometimes have <50 samples per minute.
sasha: two suggestions: (1) surface 'quantile confidence' or sample count next to percentile. (2) add warning when p99 < p95.
jamal: we could add a heuristic: if merged sample_count < 200, mark percentiles provisional and show 'may be inverted due to rollup compression'.
ed: also consider switching to histogram buckets for dashboard: deterministic monotonic behavior if buckets are aligned cluster-wide.
zara: but bucket alignment across hosts is tricky. current backend uses host-local binning with different boundaries.
mira: for short-term, can we add a UX banner and link to docs explaining why p99 may be lower, plus a 'recompute exact' button that runs a non-rollup query?
sasha: agree. I'll file a tiny console ticket and add the banner copy. Jamal, can you prototype the 'recompute exact' API?
jamal: on it. I'll experiment with merging raw samples for small ranges and report perf cost.
ops-bot: deploybot: rolled out dashboard copy change to staging at 1988881250
ed: thanks. one more: add an example query snippet in docs explaining tdigest merge inversion
mira: thanks all. if anyone sees other routes with weird quantile order, drop them here.
